news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems CEO and Director Exercise Stock Options
news.summary: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercised a fully-vested option for 1,402 shares at $0.75 on July 22, and director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 shares at the same $0.75 strike on July 24, ahead of the option expirations; no shares were sold in either filing.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 7, 2026, followed by a management webcast conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 60,000 restricted stock units of Class A common stock to a newly hired employee as a material inducement to employment, with the award vesting in three equal annual installments.

news.headline: KeyBanc Cuts Rapid Micro Biosystems Price Target to $5, Maintains Overweight Rating
news.summary: KeyBanc analyst Paul Knight reduced his price target on RPID to $5 from $8 while maintaining an Overweight rating, following the company's dilutive May equity and warrant offering.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Pricing of Up to Approximately $32 Million Underwritten Offering
news.summary: Existing investor Bain Capital Life Sciences and healthcare-focused Armistice Capital priced a dilutive offering of Class A common stock and Series A/B warrants at $1.955 per unit, raising roughly $9.8M upfront with potential proceeds of up to about $32M if all warrants are exercised.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q1 2026 revenue grew 11% year-over-year to $8.0 million on 6 Growth Direct system placements (vs. 3 a year earlier) and roughly 30% recurring-revenue growth, beating consensus, but the net loss widened to about $14.3 million versus expectations; the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance of $37M-$41M revenue and 30-38 placements.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Rapid Micro Biosystems will report second-quarter 2026 results before market open with an 8:30 a.m. ET webcast; investors will watch system placement pace, cash burn, and progress toward full-year guidance.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 revenue and placement guidance
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to $37M-$41M total revenue and 30-38 Growth Direct system placements for 2026 with ~20% gross margin; Q2 results will show whether the company is tracking to this range after a Q1 beat on revenue but a wider-than-expected net loss.

catalysts.label: Continued Growth Direct rollout with anchor accounts
catalysts.detail: Following recent multi-system expansion orders from Amgen (Q4 2025) and Samsung Biologics (Q1 2026), further follow-on orders from existing large pharma customers remain a potential upside catalyst.

pulse: RPID shares remain deeply out of favor in 2026, trading in the roughly $1.70-$2.20 range through July after touching a 52-week low near $1.66, weighed down by the dilutive ~$9.8M (up to ~$32M with warrants) May financing from Bain Capital Life Sciences and Armistice Capital that prompted KeyBanc and Lake Street to cut price targets (to $5 and $7 respectively) while still keeping bullish ratings. Operationally the story is one of steady but uneven progress: Q1 2026 revenue rose 11% to $8.0M on record system placements and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $37M-$41M, yet the net loss widened, and recent news flow has been light-limited to a routine June employee inducement grant and small July insider option exercises by the CEO and a director. The next major catalyst is the Q2 2026 earnings report on August 7, 2026, which will test whether placement momentum and cost discipline are translating into progress toward full-year targets and easing investor concern over cash burn and further dilution.
